info.name: Soft7 - Dynamic Plan Add-ons (Superadmin Pricing + Company Wallet)
info.description: Superadmin controls global pack prices. Company admins choose addons [{addon_id, enabled}] on plan definitions. Registration ensures four shared default packs: WABA number x1, Chatbot x1, Team member x1 and Contacts x3000, initially INR 20 each. Set base_url, JWT variables, user_id and subscription_plan_id. Load existing default pack IDs before creating extra custom packs. Enabling a pack does not charge money or add capacity. Assignments snapshot selections; purchases require an enabled selected pack and an included finite feature. Purchase requests debit the company wallet at the CURRENT superadmin catalog price. INR 20 = 2000 paise. Add-ons expire with the assigned paid plan, without recurring renewal/proration. Retain the per-purchase Idempotency-Key for retries and use a new key for a new purchase. Importing this file does not execute requests. No live credentials are included. Company admins can create owned WabaNumber, Chatbot and TeamInvite packs with name/units/active only. Each starts at INR 20; superadmin alone can edit price_paise. Company listings/plans/purchases isolate owned packs by authenticated company. Shared packs remain read-only to company admins.

item.name: 1. Superadmin - create add-on packs
item.description: The four registration default packs already exist. Load their IDs from the company admin catalog; do not recreate them. These optional create requests add extra custom packs to the superadmin catalog. All example prices are INR 20 (2000 paise). Create responses save their IDs; use PATCH for later price/status changes. Only superadmin can create/edit prices.

request.description: Read canonical feature keys, kinds, active status and addon_allowed.
Includes active and disabled packs. Reuse existing IDs instead of recreating packs.
Adds 1 WabaNumber unit(s) per pack for INR 20. Example price: edit before sending if needed. Server requires an active feature with addon_allowed=true. Saves waba_addon_id.
Adds 1 Chatbot unit(s) per pack for INR 20. Example price: edit before sending if needed. Server requires an active feature with addon_allowed=true. Saves chatbot_addon_id.
Adds 1 TeamInvite unit(s) per pack for INR 20. Example price: edit before sending if needed. Server requires an active feature with addon_allowed=true. Saves team_addon_id.
Optional additional contacts pack: 3,000 contacts per pack at INR 20. The registration default already exists and can be reused. Saves contacts_addon_id.
Adds 10 Campaign unit(s) per pack for INR 20. Example price: edit before sending if needed. Server requires an active feature with addon_allowed=true. Saves campaigns_addon_id.
Adds 1 AiAssistant unit(s) per pack for INR 20. Example price: edit before sending if needed. Server requires an active feature with addon_allowed=true. Saves ai_addon_id.

item.name: 2. Superadmin - change prices
item.description: Price edits are dynamic and affect FUTURE purchases. Previous purchases keep their saved charge, units and expiry. Change price_paise in these requests; feature_key cannot be edited.

request.description: 2000 paise = INR 20. Send 3000 to charge INR 30 for future purchases. Existing purchases are not repriced.
Set the current platform price for one extra chatbot. This does not debit any wallet.

item.name: Edit any pack - price, units, name, publication

request.description: Set addon_id to any existing pack UUID. Any non-empty subset of name, units, price_paise and active is accepted. feature_key is immutable.

item.name: 3. Company admin - display prices and current plan
item.description: Use a company admin JWT. Set user_id to the recipient UUID in that company. Prices shown in the UI come from the platform catalog, not a frontend constant. user_plan_id is the assigned user_plans UUID, not the subscription_plans definition UUID.

item.name: Get current platform charges and active add-ons

request.description: data.addons contains active packs and integer price_paise values. Display INR = price_paise / 100. Refetch when opening the purchase form. Platform activation fees are separate from add-on prices.
Only active packs are listed. Feature eligibility still depends on the selected assigned plan.

item.name: Get recipient plan and save user_plan_id

request.description: Returns data.user_plan_id, billing_cycle, dates and features with base_limit, addon_limit and effective_limit. Saves user_plan_id for subsequent purchases. Recipient needs an active, unexpired PAID plan.
Catalog definitions are separate from assigned plans. Registration defaults Basic, Pro and Enterprise are inactive until explicitly published; catalog IDs cannot be used as user_plan_id.

item.name: 3a. Company admin - enable or disable add-ons in a plan
item.description: Plan selections contain IDs/booleans only. Prices remain controlled by superadmin. Enable does not charge/add capacity. Omission on create = []; omission on update preserves selections; [] clears them. Updates affect future assignments. Existing assignments keep their snapshot.

request.description: Loads the four active shared defaults created during registration/migration. Saves WABA, Chatbot, Team and Contacts pack IDs for form/purchase examples. Superadmin price/status edits are preserved.

request.description: subscription_plan_id is a company catalog definition UUID. Returns full catalog including inactive packs and the plan-specific enabled switches. Use these rows to build the edit form.
Example: enable WABA, Chatbot and Contacts, disable Team members. Replace the entire addons selection list. The definition must have finite limits for enabled pack features.

item.name: Create a plan with add-on switches

request.description: Creates an inactive Pro catalog definition with selectable add-ons. This does not assign/activate it. Prices/units are not accepted inside addons entries.

item.name: 4. Company admin - purchase extra capacity (wallet debit)
item.description: These POST requests debit the company wallet and credit the platform wallet. At the current INR 20 prices, one WABA pack plus one Chatbot pack costs INR 40 total. No payment checkout is used. The server reads current catalog prices; never submit price_paise or units in a purchase. Each request keeps its own Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Clear/set a new key only when intentionally making a NEW purchase. Free, expired, disabled-feature and unlimited-feature plans cannot purchase the corresponding add-on.

request.description: Adds one pack of WABA-number capacity to this active paid assignment. With units=1 and price_paise=2000, allowance increases by 1 and wallet debit is INR 20. It does not create/register a Meta number or automatically activate previously inactive numbers. The assigned plan must include this pack with enabled=true (or retain historical null selections); changing a catalog plan affects future assignments only.

item.name: 5. Superadmin - disable or restore a pack
item.description: Catalog maintenance. Disabling prevents future purchases without removing previous purchases or their capacity.

request.description: Set addon_id to the selected pack. This soft-disables the pack; it does not refund or remove previous purchases.
Re-enable an existing pack for future purchases at its saved catalog price.

item.name: 6. Optional - future feature catalog
item.description: For a new feature only. Registering a catalog key does not implement resource enforcement; the corresponding resource service must support that feature. Standard six feature keys must not be registered again. developer_api currently does not allow add-ons.

request.description: Example new capacity feature. Change custom_feature_key/label/description to match a real feature implemented by your backend. Only superadmin can register it.

item.name: 9. Admin - extend assigned subscription
Preview extension allowance and live monthly fee

request.description: Read-only preview: current expiry, total extra days used/remaining, minimum request days, live monthly platform fee and whether that assignment already paid/waived its one-time fee. This request fills extension_expected_end_date only if it is empty; clear it explicitly to start a deliberate new extension.

item.name: Extend current user plan by days

request.description: Use user_plans.id, including Free if desired. Requests accept only days, expected_end_date and optional reason. A 30-day request charges the current monthly platform fee once (initially INR 100); the default extension_days is 10. Counters persist on user_plans. Existing extensions count toward the 30-day total cap. HTTP 409 rejects a stale expiry or exhausted allowance. Wallet, ledger, date, pack expiry and audit updates are atomic. Never automatically replace the expected timestamp on retry.

exec: pm.test("Extension succeeds or a stale request is rejected", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 409]); });
// Retain extension_expected_end_date to make retries safe.

item.description: Each assigned user plan can receive at most 30 extra days in total. Each request must add 5 through 30 days. The first 10 cumulative days are free; crossing 10 debits the current monthly platform fee (initially INR 100) from the target company wallet exactly once. Later extensions of the same plan do not charge again. Preview policy and fee before granting time.
